title: omp-web theme file
description: A custom omp-web theme: <config dir>/themes/<stem>.json (default ~/.omp-web/themes/). The file stem is the theme id and must match [a-z0-9-]+.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL for editor completion and validation.

schemaVersion.description: Theme file schema version. Newer versions than the running omp-web understands are rejected; older ones are migrated.

name.description: Display name shown in the theme picker.

variants.description: Palettes per color scheme. Provide dark, light, or both. A theme with only one variant is offered only for that scheme.

color.description: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, oklch(L% C h) or oklch(L% C h / a). No other color syntax is accepted.

variant.description: One palette. The nine core tokens are required; omitted optional tokens are derived from them.

panel.description: Raised surfaces: cards, dialogs, popovers, the sidebar.

accent.description: Interactive accent: links, focus rings, selected state, primary actions.

success.description: Success status: ok badges, added lines, running indicators.

warning.description: Warning status: caution badges and notices.

error.description: Error status: failures, destructive actions, removed lines.

bg-deep.description: Recessed surfaces darker (or further from the viewer) than bg: code wells, the composer field.

panel-2.description: A second panel level nested on panel.

hover.description: Hover and pressed fill for rows and buttons.

backdrop.description: Scrim behind modals. Usually carries alpha.

shadow-color.description: Color of drop shadows. Usually carries alpha.

muted-2.description: Mid-emphasis text between muted and text. Derived values are lifted to 4.5:1 on bg and panel.

muted-3.description: Higher-emphasis secondary text, closest to text. Derived values are lifted to 4.5:1 on bg and panel.

shimmer-band.description: Highlight band of the loading shimmer sweep.

error-text.description: Text color for error messages on error-bg.

accent-dim.description: Subtle accent fill: selected rows, chips.

purple.description: Secondary accent used for special features and the default settings accent.

success-bg.description: Background of success notices and badges.

success-border.description: Border of success notices and badges.

warning-bg.description: Background of warning notices and badges.

warning-border.description: Border of warning notices and badges.

error-bg.description: Background of error notices and badges.

error-border.description: Border of error notices and badges.

diff-add-bg.description: Background of added lines in diffs. Usually carries alpha.

diff-add-text.description: Text color of added lines in diffs.

diff-del-bg.description: Background of removed lines in diffs. Usually carries alpha.

diff-del-text.description: Text color of removed lines in diffs.

tool-shell.description: Tool category color: shell and command tools. Derived tool hues avoid red and green.

tool-read.description: Tool category color: read and fetch tools.

tool-write.description: Tool category color: write and edit tools.

tool-search.description: Tool category color: search and find tools.

tool-agents.description: Tool category color: subagent and task tools.

tool-other.description: Tool category color: all other tools.

syn-title.description: Syntax highlighting: function and heading names.

syn-attr.description: Syntax highlighting: types, attributes and properties.

syn-meta.description: Syntax highlighting: preprocessor and meta tokens.

settings-accent.description: Accent inside the Settings surfaces (toggles, group marks).

settings-warning.description: Warning text and marks in Settings.

settings-mark-bg.description: Background of the search-match mark in Settings.

settings-mark-fg.description: Text color of the search-match mark in Settings.

logo-tile.description: Tile color of the omp-web logo mark.

logo-base.description: Base band color of the omp-web logo mark.
